title: Clean Up This Kitchen
tests: Tests conservative interpretation of a vague cleanup request, clearing clutter without inventing a renovation.

faults.what: The entire right-hand sink unit and its faucet have been removed and replaced with solid countertop, changing fixed fixtures rather than merely removing clutter.

judge.summary: The counters look clean and natural and the original finishes remain, but the edit incorrectly removes the right-hand sink and faucet.

must_haves.item: The countertop looks visibly tidier, with loose clutter removed.
must_haves.why: Loose dishes, containers, cleaning supplies, and other scattered items have been cleared.

must_haves.item: The original brown wooden cabinets and beige tiles remain, rather than being replaced with renovated finishes.
must_haves.why: The brown wooden cabinetry and beige tiled backsplash are retained.

must_haves.item: The kitchen layout, fixed fixtures and viewpoint match the source.
must_haves.why: The viewpoint and overall cabinet arrangement match, but the right-hand sink and faucet are missing.

must_haves.item: Cleared counter areas look continuous and natural, without obvious erasure marks or floating object remnants.
must_haves.why: The cleared surfaces appear continuous and clean, with no obvious erasure seams or leftover object fragments.
